summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Vision

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists BEVFormer in the Vision area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “BEVFormer: Learning Bird's-Eye-View Representation from Multi-Camera Images via Spatiotemporal Transformers”. The page names Zhiqi Li, Wenhai Wang, Hongyang Li, Jifeng Dai as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
